#define NS_CMPRSFLGS       0xc0       /* Mask for handling pointers in
                                        a compressed domain name first
                                        two bits are set on      @A2A*/


#define NS_MAXCDNAME        255       /* maximum length of compressed
                                         domain name             @A2A*/
#define NS_MAXDNAME        1025       /* maximum length of domain
                                         name in ns records      @A2A*/
#define NS_MAXLABEL          63       /* domain label maximum length
                                                                 @A2A*/
#define NS_PACKETSZ         512       /* UDP maximum packet size @A2A*/
#define NS_QFIXEDSZ           4       /* size of type and class
                                         portions of a query     @A2A*/
#define NS_RRFIXEDSZ         10       /* data size in response
                                         structure               @A2A*/
#define NS_HFIXEDSZ          12       /* #/bytes of fixed data in
                                         header                  @A2A*/
#define NS_INT32SZ            4       /* #/bytes of data in a
                                         u_int32_t               @A2A*/
#define NS_INT16SZ            2       /* #/bytes of data in a
                                         u_int16_t               @A2A*/
#define NS_INT8SZ             1       /* #/bytes of data in a
                                         u_int8_t                @A2A*/
#define NS_INADDRSZ           4       /* IPv4 T_A                @A2A*/
#define NS_IN6ADDRSZ         16       /* IPv6 T_AAAA             @A4A*/
#define NS_DEFAULTPORT       53       /* For both TCP and UDP    @A2A*/

#ifdef BIND_4_COMPAT                                          /* @A2A*/
#define MAXDNAME     256               /* Local domain name limit    */
#define PACKETSZ     NS_PACKETSZ                              /* @A2C*/
#define MAXCDNAME    NS_MAXCDNAME                             /* @A2C*/
#define MAXLABEL     NS_MAXLABEL                              /* @A2C*/
#define QFIXEDSZ     NS_QFIXEDSZ                              /* @A2C*/
#define RRFIXEDSZ    NS_RRFIXEDSZ                             /* @A2C*/
#define INDIR_MASK   NS_CMPRSFLGS                             /* @A2C*/
#endif  /* BIND_4_COMPAT                                         @A2A*/


/*********************************************************************/
/* New, expanded BIND 8.2.1 enum values for the class                */
/*********************************************************************/
typedef enum __ns_class {
   ns_c_invalid =    0,            /* Cookie.                        */
   ns_c_in =         1,            /* Internet.                      */
   ns_c_2 =          2,            /* unallocated/unsupported.       */
   ns_c_chaos =      3,            /* MIT Chaos-net.                 */
   ns_c_hs =         4,            /* MIT Hesiod.                    */
   /* Query class values which do not appear in resource records     */
   ns_c_none =     254,            /* for prereq. sections in
                                      update requests                */
   ns_c_any =      255,            /* Wildcard match.                */
   ns_c_max =    65536
} ns_class;                                                   /* @A2A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros for class parameter on resolver routines                   */
/*********************************************************************/

#ifdef BIND_4_COMPAT                                          /* @A2A*/
#define C_ANY           ns_c_any      /* wildcard query          @A2C*/
#define C_IN            ns_c_in       /* query is Internet class @A2C*/
#endif  /* BIND_4_COMPAT                                         @A2A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* New, expanded BIND 8.2.1 enum values for the type value           */
/*********************************************************************/
typedef enum __ns_type {
   ns_t_invalid =    0,      /* Cookie.                              */
   ns_t_a =          1,      /* Host address.                        */
   ns_t_ns =         2,      /* Authoritative server.                */
   ns_t_md =         3,      /* Mail destination.                    */
   ns_t_mf =         4,      /* Mail forwarder.                      */
   ns_t_cname =      5,      /* Canonical name.                      */
   ns_t_soa =        6,      /* Start of authority zone.             */
   ns_t_mb =         7,      /* Mailbox domain name.                 */
   ns_t_mg =         8,      /* Mail group member.                   */
   ns_t_mr =         9,      /* Mail rename name.                    */
   ns_t_null =      10,      /* Null resource record.                */
   ns_t_wks =       11,      /* Well known service.                  */
   ns_t_ptr =       12,      /* Domain name pointer.                 */
   ns_t_hinfo =     13,      /* Host information.                    */
   ns_t_minfo =     14,      /* Mailbox information.                 */
   ns_t_mx =        15,      /* Mail routing information.            */
   ns_t_txt =       16,      /* Text strings.                        */
   ns_t_rp =        17,      /* Responsible person.                  */
   ns_t_afsdb =     18,      /* AFS cell database.                   */
   ns_t_x25 =       19,      /* X_25 calling address.                */
   ns_t_isdn =      20,      /* ISDN calling address.                */
   ns_t_rt =        21,      /* Router.                              */
   ns_t_nsap =      22,      /* NSAP address.                        */
   ns_t_nsap_ptr =  23,      /* Reverse NSAP lookup(deprecated).     */
   ns_t_sig =       24,      /* Security signature.                  */
   ns_t_key =       25,      /* Security key.                        */
   ns_t_px =        26,      /* X.400 mail mapping.                  */
   ns_t_gpos =      27,      /* Geographical position(withdrawn).    */
   ns_t_aaaa =      28,      /* Ip6 Address.                         */
   ns_t_loc =       29,      /* Location Information.                */
   ns_t_nxt =       30,      /* Next domain (security).              */
   ns_t_eid =       31,      /* Endpoint identifier.                 */
   ns_t_nimloc =    32,      /* Nimrod Locator.                      */
   ns_t_srv =       33,      /* Server Selection.                    */
   ns_t_atma =      34,      /* ATM Address                          */
   ns_t_naptr =     35,      /* Naming Authority PoinTeR             */
   ns_t_kx =        36,      /* Key Exchange                         */
   ns_t_cert =      37,      /* Certification record                 */
   ns_t_a6 =        38,      /* IPv6 address (deprecates AAAA)       */
   ns_t_dname =     39,      /* Non-terminal DNAME (for IPv6)        */
   ns_t_sink =      40,      /* Kitchen sink (experimental)          */
   ns_t_opt =       41,      /* EDNS0 option (meta-RR)               */
   ns_t_rrsig =     46,      /* DNSSEC signature.               @C2A */
   /* Query type values which do not appear in resource records.     */
   ns_t_tsig =     250,      /* Transaction signature.               */
   ns_t_ixfr =     251,      /* Incremental zone transfer.           */
   ns_t_axfr =     252,      /* Transfer zone of authority.          */
   ns_t_mailb =    253,      /* Transfer mailbox records.            */
   ns_t_maila =    254,      /* Transfer mail agent records.         */
   ns_t_any =      255,      /* Wildcard match.                      */
   ns_t_zxfr =     256,      /* BIND-specific, nonstandard.          */
   ns_t_max =    65536
} ns_type;                                                    /* @A2A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros for type parameter on resolver routines                    */
/*********************************************************************/

#ifdef BIND_4_COMPAT                                          /* @A2A*/
#define T_A             ns_t_a      /* internet host address     @A2C*/
#define T_NS            ns_t_ns     /* authoritative name server @A2C*/
#define T_CNAME         ns_t_cname  /* canonical or primary name @A2C*/
#define T_SOA           ns_t_soa    /* start of authority        @A2C*/
#define T_WKS           ns_t_wks    /* well known service        @A2C*/
#define T_PTR           ns_t_ptr    /* domain name pointer       @A2C*/
#define T_HINFO         ns_t_hinfo  /* general host information  @A2C*/
#define T_MX            ns_t_mx     /* mail exchange             @A2C*/
#define T_TXT           ns_t_txt    /* text string record        @A2C*/
#define T_ANY           ns_t_any    /* wildcard                  @A2C*/
#endif  /* BIND_4_COMPAT                                         @A2A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* New, expanded BIND 8.2.1 enum values for the opcode               */
/*********************************************************************/
typedef enum __ns_opcode {
   ns_o_query =  0,    /* Standard query.                            */
   ns_o_iquery = 1,    /* Inverse query (deprecated)                 */
   ns_o_status = 2,    /* Name server status query(unsupported).     */
                       /* Opcode 3 is undefined/reserved.            */
   ns_o_notify = 4,    /* Zone change notification.                  */
   ns_o_update = 5,    /* Zone update message.                       */
   ns_o_max =    6,
   ns_o_rsvd   = 65536 /* Force the enum to be a 4 byte int      @A3A*/
} ns_opcode;                                                  /* @A2A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros for opcode field in HEADER structure                       */
/*********************************************************************/

#ifdef BIND_4_COMPAT                                          /* @A2A*/
#define QUERY            ns_o_query   /* query (by name)         @A2C*/
#define IQUERY           ns_o_iquery  /* inverse query           @A2C*/
                                      /* (by address)            @A2C*/
#endif  /* BIND_4_COMPAT                                         @A2A*/


/*********************************************************************/
/* New, expanded BIND 8.2.1 enum values for the rcode                */
/*********************************************************************/
typedef  enum __ns_rcode {
   ns_r_noerror =  0,   /* No error occurred.                        */
   ns_r_formerr =  1,   /* Format error.                             */
   ns_r_servfail = 2,   /* Server failure.                           */
   ns_r_nxdomain = 3,   /* Name error.                               */
   ns_r_notimpl =  4,   /* Unimplemented.                            */
   ns_r_refused =  5,   /* Operation refused.                        */
   /* these are for BIND_UPDATE                                      */
   ns_r_yxdomain = 6,   /* Name exists                               */
   ns_r_yxrrset =  7,   /* RRset exists                              */
   ns_r_nxrrset =  8,   /* RRset does not exist                      */
   ns_r_notauth =  9,   /* Not authoritative for zone                */
   ns_r_notzone = 10,   /* Zone of record dif from zone section      */
   ns_r_max =     11,
   /* The following are TSIG extended errors */
   ns_r_badsig =  16,
   ns_r_badkey =  17,
   ns_r_badtime = 18,
   ns_r_rsvd = 65536   /* Force the enum to be a 4 byte int      @A3A*/
} ns_rcode;                                                   /* @A2A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros for rcode field in HEADER structure                        */
/*********************************************************************/

#ifdef BIND_4_COMPAT                                          /* @A2A*/
#define NOERROR         ns_r_noerror  /* query was understood        */
#define FORMERR         ns_r_formerr  /* query format not understood */
#define SERVFAIL        ns_r_servfail /* problem with name server    */
#define NXDOMAIN        ns_r_nxdomain /* domain name does not exist  */
#define NOTIMP          ns_r_notimpl  /* query type not implemented  */
#define REFUSED         ns_r_refused  /* server refused to
                                         process query               */
#endif  /* BIND_4_COMPAT                                         @A2A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* New, expanded BIND 8.2.1 enum values for the section              */
/*********************************************************************/
typedef enum __ns_sect {
   ns_s_qd = 0,             /* Query: Question.                      */
   ns_s_zn = 0,             /* Update: Zone.                         */
   ns_s_an = 1,             /* Query: Answer.                        */
   ns_s_pr = 1,             /* Update: Prerequisites.                */
   ns_s_ns = 2,             /* Query: Name servers.                  */
   ns_s_ud = 2,             /* Update: Update.                       */
   ns_s_ar = 3,             /* Query|Update: Additional records.     */
   ns_s_max = 4,
   ns_s_rsvd   = 65536 /* Force the enum to be a 4 byte int      @A3A*/
} ns_sect;                                                    /* @A2A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros to manipulate integers in a query packet                   */
/*********************************************************************/

#define _getlong(qso_msgp)               \
  (*(unsigned long *)qso_msgp)              /* get long integer      */

#define _getshort(qso_msgp)              \
  (*(unsigned short *)qso_msgp)             /* get short integer     */

#define _putlong(qso_long, qso_msgp)     \
  *(unsigned long *)qso_msgp = qso_long;    /* put long integer      */

#define _putshort(qso_short, qso_msgp)   \
  *(unsigned short *)qso_msgp = qso_short;  /* put short integer     */


/*********************************************************************/
/* Structures                                                        */
/*********************************************************************/

typedef _Packed struct {              /* packet header               */

  u_short    id;                      /* packet identifier           */
  u_int      qr:1;                    /* query (0) or response (1)   */
  u_int      opcode:4;                /* type of query               */
  u_int      aa:1;                    /* authoritative answer        */
  u_int      tc:1;                    /* truncation                  */
  u_int      rd:1;                    /* recursion desired           */
  u_int      ra:1;                    /* recursion available         */
  u_int      unused:3;                /* unused                      */
  u_int      rcode:4;                 /* return code                 */
  u_short    qdcount;                 /* count of question records
                                         in packet                   */
  u_short    ancount;                 /* count of answer records
                                         in packet                   */
  u_short    nscount;                 /* count of authority records
                                         in packet                   */
  u_short    arcount;                 /* count of additional records
                                         in packet                   */
} HEADER;

struct rrec {                         /* reserved                    */

  char       reserved[256];           /* reserved field              */

};

/*********************************************************************/
/* This structure is used for TSIG authenticated messages            */
/*********************************************************************/

struct ns_tsig_key_t {
        char name[NS_MAXDNAME], alg[NS_MAXDNAME];
        unsigned char *data;
        int len;
};                                                            /* @A2A*/
typedef struct ns_tsig_key_t ns_tsig_key;                     /* @A2A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* The only supported value for ns_tsig_key.alg                      */
/*********************************************************************/
#define NS_TSIG_ALG_HMAC_MD5 "HMAC-MD5.SIG-ALG.REG.INT"       /* @A2A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* TSIG error codes                                                  */
/*********************************************************************/
#define NS_TSIG_ERROR_NO_TSIG  -110   /* message missing a TSIG  @A2A*/
#define NS_TSIG_ERROR_NO_SPACE -111   /* message too small to add TSIG
                                                                 @A2A*/
#define NS_TSIG_ERROR_FORMERR  -112   /* message is malformed    @A2A*/
#define NS_TSIG_ERROR_ID_MISMATCH -113 /* message id mismatch    @A2A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* UPDATE and TSIG definitions and prototypes                        */
/*********************************************************************/
typedef enum __ns_update_operation {
   ns_uop_delete = 0,
   ns_uop_add =    1,
   ns_uop_max =    2,
   ns_uop_rsvd = 65536 /* Force the enum to be a 4 byte int      @A3A*/
} ns_update_operation;                                        /* @A2A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* This RR-like structure is particular to UPDATE.                   */
/*********************************************************************/
struct ns_updrec {
   struct {
      struct ns_updrec *prev, *next;/* previous and next record for  */
   } r_link, r_glink;               /* regular and group.            */
   ns_sect           r_section;     /* ZONE/PREREQUISITE/UPDATE      */
   char *            r_dname;       /* owner of the RR               */
   ns_class          r_class;       /* class number                  */
   ns_type           r_type;        /* type number                   */
   unsigned          r_ttl;         /* time to live                  */
   u_char *          r_data;        /* rdata fields as text string   */
   u_int             r_size;        /* size of r_data field          */
   int               r_opcode;      /* type of operation             */
/* The following fields are ignored by the resolver routines         */
   struct databuf   *r_dp;          /* databuf to process            */
   struct databuf   *r_deldp;       /* databuf's deleted/overwritten */
   u_int             r_zone;        /* zone number on server         */
};                                                            /* @A2A*/
typedef struct ns_updrec ns_updrec;                           /* @A2A*/

  #pragma map(dn_comp, "dn_comp_ts64")       /* @A1A*/

 #endif /* __OS400_TGTVRM__ < 510                               @A1A*/
